text.capture.ts: Listens for uncaught exceptions, unhandled rejections, windows and helper processes that crashed or stopped responding, and records each one in the Diagnostics log
text.capture.ts gotcha: Uncaught errors use the monitor event, so Electron's own error dialog still appears.
text.editor.ts: Turns what the embedded editor page reports (console errors, a failed load, freezing) into editor log entries, dropping known harmless messages and repeats and removing the connection token from addresses
text.editor.ts gotcha: Aborted loads and sub-frame failures are ignored; console errors stay warnings.
text.editor-server.ts: Turns the VS Code server's stderr lines, exit code or signal, launch error and last health check into log entries, with the command that was run and a Windows hint
text.editor-server.ts gotcha: Stderr entries stop after a fixed number per start, so a noisy server cannot fill the log.
text.github.ts: Builds the GitHub issue link from a redacted report, moving a long report to the clipboard and keeping only a short summary in a link under the length limit
text.github.ts gotcha: The link host, repository and path are fixed; a link that does not match isIssueUrl is never opened.
text.index.ts: Holds the one running Diagnostics service so any module can record a problem, doing nothing until the app has started it
text.ipc-guard.ts: Wraps every IPC handler registered after it so a thrown error or rejected promise is recorded and then thrown on unchanged
text.ipc-guard.ts gotcha: Only handlers registered after it is installed are wrapped, so it must run before the first ipcMain.handle.
text.ipc.ts: Answers the Diagnostics channels from trusted windows: a validated window error, live watching, copy report, open the issue page on GitHub and the crash notice, with every request checked
text.ipc.ts gotcha: The window sends only an entry id; the link is always built here, never taken from the window.
text.lifecycle.ts: Decides from the log whether the previous run crashed or ended without a normal quit, and names the start and quit markers
text.record.ts: Builds one log entry with its time, run, platform and version, redacting and limiting its text, and describes a thrown value as a message and stack
text.redact.ts: Removes home folders, project folders and tokens from text, on top of the credential patterns the account code already uses
text.report.ts: Formats the environment and entries as a redacted text report, and a short summary of the worst entries
text.rotation.ts: Reads the log tolerating a torn line, and drops the oldest entries past the entry, size and age bounds
text.service.ts: Runs the Diagnostics log for one app run: records entries through a throttle, marks start and quit, finds a crash of the previous run, and gives the report context
text.service.ts gotcha: begin() must wait for the single-instance lock, or a second launch would log a start with no quit.
text.store.ts: Appends entries to the JSON lines log in the user-data folder with private permissions, rewrites it within its bounds and tells subscribers about each new entry
text.throttle.ts: Lets a key through only a few times per time window, so a repeating failure cannot flood the log
